title.narrative: Indicator 1: Percentage of girl leaders who have improved knowledge of their rights, entitlement and legal protection, and improved perception of self

description.narrative: Indicator 1: Percentage of girl leaders who have improved knowledge of their rights, entitlement and legal protection, and improved perception of self

comment.narrative: 85 of girl leaders 127 out of 150

After three phases of capacitybuilding an average of 85 of the girl participants demonstrated improved knowledge of their rights entitlements and legal protection as well as improved selfperception and are able to assess protection risks and gender equality gaps faced specifically by girls and identify possible actions to address these. There were varied numbers of participants per phase when their knowledge and abilities were measured for improvement. The pretest average score of 81 increased to 89 in the posttest marking the highest posttest average score for the indicator pertaining to knowledge of rights entitlements and legal protection similarly the pretest average score of 81 increased to 85 in the posttest for the indicator related to selfperception.Capacitybuilding phases were held once a month in respective municipalities of the participants from October 15 2022 to February 5 2023 depending on the availability of the participants who are all in school and other prior personal commitments religious matters health conditions emergencies.During the initial phases activities were held in their respective municipalities but for the second and third phases the team sought a better venue a childfriendly setting in order for children to listen learn and enjoy the activity.

comment.narrative: At least 150 girls

Organizing of girls Layer 3 The 75 core girls organized an activity with their chosen topic per municipality and planned the rollout in their respective barangays. Each barangay invited of at least 15 girls aged 1017 years old. However only 13 of the 15 target barangays were able to conduct the Organizing of Girls Layer 3 activity two remaining barangays Lanao Kuran and Bagumbayan were unable to do the activity because core leaders were not present in their respective barangays due to work and vacation as the school year came to an end. Magpet chose Discrimination as their topic Arakan chose Child Marriage and Makilala chose Sexual Harassment. Since 15 invites were set in each barangay the total reached is 179 with an unintentional 29 reached. Additionally there is one reachedout in the barangay who is LGBTQ a boy assigned at birth and one nineyearold girl. Makilala has the highest count of participants with 37 67 Arakan with 36 65 and Magpet with 26 47. Ranged in age from 9 to 17 years old with 1 9 12 10 and 14 10 11 23 12 15 13 and 15 9 16 and 3 17 attendees. The participants are all female. In this activity three layers of organizing of girls was conducted aiding to address issues on SGBV and discrimination and strengthen their capacity for collective analysis self and peer protection action planning monitoring campaigning and advocacy.

comment.narrative: 60 of core girl leaders 45 out of 75

Among the 75 girl leaders 57 expressed improved selfesteem and an increased capacity to claim their rights e.g. decisionmaking skills negotiation public speaking advocacy achieving 76 compared to a target of 60. Based on the endline evaluation of the project the girls felt capable and optimistic about participating in and advocating for gender equality initiatives. They have a moderately high level of selfconfidence in their ability to raise awareness about gender inequality and genderbased violence through their own campaigns. The girls also feel more confident to raise their agenda to government entities when in a group rather than on their own which is aligned with the project espousing collective action. During organizing of girls series of capacity building Organizing 1 composed of layer 13 organizing 2 and organizing 3 were done to capacitate coregirl leaders to identify issues that they have seen to have a significant negative impact in their lives as children. Coregirls were trained to identify and gave possible solutions to their identified issues using a problem and solution tree activity. Next activity was training on facilitation skills and organizing their own activity in preparation for the implementation of the identified issues in their respective barangays. At the end of the capacity building Coreleaders do publicspeaking delivered their certain advocacies through awareness raising poster and slogan making. out of 75 there were 53 girls who were able to conduct the organizing layer 3 in their respective barangays. Identified issue in Makialala was Sexual Harassment Magpet was discrimination and Arakan was child marriage.

comment.narrative: 50 of core girl leaders 37 out of 75

As of August 8 2024. Series of capacity building of Organizing of girls were done composed of 3 Layers. Layer 1 with 3 capacity buildings attended by 35 core girls during Layer 1 Capacity Building 1 then Layer 1 Capacity building 2 with 27 attendees and Layer 1 Capacity Building 3 with the attendance of 26 core girl leaders. Layer 2 batch 1 with 27 core girls and Layer 2 batch 2 with 13 core girls attended comprising of 40 girls serves as the invites of 35 core girls thus making of 75 girls that were organized. Overall participants from Makilala were 29 girls Arakan with 25 girls and Magpet with 21 girls. Activities were held at FCG Hotel and Evas Hotel both located in Kidapawan City. Layer 3 of activities were conducted at the respected barangays of the target areas. However only 13 barangays were able to conduct the layer 3 activity. 2 barangays Bagumabayan and Lanao Kuran were not able to conduct the activity due to trained girls were not present in their barangays one stated that she will transfer to other municipality and will continue her schooling there while Lanao Kuran girls went to other region to do vacation work since it was the end of school year. Among the 75 girl leaders who built their leadership capacities including listening speaking advocating and organizing 71 53 girls were able to showcase their skills through conducting various activities with girls in their communities. Upon reflecting on the activities done they realized how their nervousness affected their way of explaining their topics. However they were proud and pleased with themselves and their collective efforts to accomplish their goal. Although reaching more than the minimum target 60 it is seen as a challenge to sustainability in specific barangays if not all girl leaders are able to continuously broaden their influence or practice the leadership skills that they gained.
